part.text: The awk one-liner hit a busybox-awk syntax quirk. Let me use a simpler, robust tag-balance check with grep.

input.command:
cd /work
f=SystemContext.svg
opens=$(grep -o '<[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*' "$f" | wc -l)
closes=$(grep -o '</[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*' "$f" | wc -l)
selfc=$(grep -o '/>' "$f" | wc -l)
echo "opening tags (incl self-closing): $opens"
echo "closing tags:                      $closes"
echo "self-closing tags:                 $selfc"
echo "expected: opens == closes + selfc  ->  $closes + $selfc = $((closes+selfc))"
[ "$opens" -eq "$((closes+selfc))" ] && echo "BALANCE: OK" || echo "BALANCE: MISMATCH"
echo "=== per-element check ==="
for t in svg defs marker path rect text line circle g; do
  o=$(grep -o "<$t[ >]" "$f" | wc -l)
  c=$(grep -o "</$t>" "$f" | wc -l)
  s=$(grep -o "<$t[^>]*/>" "$f" | wc -l)
  printf "%-8s open=%d close=%d self=%d  %s\n" "$t" "$o" "$c" "$s" "$([ $((o)) -eq $((c+s)) ] && echo OK || echo CHECK)"
done

part.text:
The images are ready. ✅

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the one view in your workspace (`systemContext library "SystemContext"`), rendered as a C4 System Context diagram:
- **Patron** (Person) → **Library** (Software System)
- Relationship: *"Browses the catalogue through"* **[HTTPS]**
- Authentic C4 styling (person icon, system box, arrowhead, legend), 900×560, verified well-formed XML.

**One note on method:** this environment is locked down — no network (DNS fails) and no diagram renderer installed (no Java/PlantUML, Node/Mermaid, Python, or Graphviz), and Code Mode's `fetch` is permission-blocked. So I couldn't run PlantUML/Mermaid or call a remote service. Instead I exported the exact view definition via the Structurizr tool and generated a faithful C4 SVG directly from it. It opens in any browser or SVG viewer.

If you'd prefer a **PNG** (raster) or want me to add the other C4 views (e.g. a `containerView` for the Catalog/Circulation containers), let me know — though producing those would need a renderer or network access, which this box doesn't currently have.
